info.title: Sweeft
info.description: Sweeft — a Jeffersoft tool. Detects build/dependency folders and old, heavy files to free up disk space.

x-inspectra.cliParsedDescription:
Detects build/dependency folders and old, heavy files to free up disk space.
Shares its configuration with the graphical interface (GUI).

options.name: --path
options.description: Root folder to analyze (or the first positional argument).

options.name: --min-size
options.description: Minimum file size. E.g. 100MB, 1.5GB. (default: config)

options.name: --min-age
options.description: Minimum file age in days. (default: config)

options.name: --only-folders
options.description: Analyze folders only; skip files.

options.name: --with-files
options.description: Force file analysis (opposite of --only-folders).

options.name: --stale
options.description:
Only clean regenerable folders of projects idle at least
this long. E.g. 90d, 2w, 6mo, 1y.

options.name: --types
options.description: Detect ONLY these types. E.g. node_modules,bin,obj

options.name: --exclude
options.description: Folders to skip entirely during traversal.

options.name: --custom
options.description:
Add a custom type. Format: name|Category|Description
(repeatable). E.g. --custom "logs|Other|Old logs"
--git/--no-git    Enable/disable Git repository state detection.

options.name: --list-types
options.description: List the catalog of detectable types and exit.

options.name: --json
options.description: Print the scan result as JSON (does not delete).

options.name: --report-only
options.description: Only show the report; never delete.

options.name: --yes
options.description: Do not ask; select EVERYTHING for deletion.

options.name: --recycle
options.description: Send to the Recycle Bin (recoverable).

options.name: --permanent
options.description: Permanent, irreversible deletion.

options.name: --force
options.description: to combine --yes with --permanent (safety guard).

options.name: --save-config
options.description: Save the parameters used as the new defaults.

options.name: --config
options.description: Use a specific configuration file.

options.name: --no-config
options.description: Ignore the saved configuration (use base values).

options.name: --help
options.description: Show this help.

options.name: --version
options.description: Show the version and exit.
